fixes.defect: HomeAlias shipped android:enabled=false with no code to enable it, so Metro never appeared in the Home chooser
fixes.resolution: Alias ships enabled (a HOME filter only makes a candidate; the system still asks the user) plus HomeRoleController for role request, withdrawal and independent diagnosis

fixes.defect: A shared highestTier meant any L1 grant unlocked every L1 capability
fixes.resolution: Each capability declares one RequiredGrant; stateFor checks that grant alone

fixes.defect: ShellViewModel.launch() called the launcher directly, so LandscapePolicyEngine.decide() was dead code
fixes.resolution: Single AppLaunchOrchestrator implementing the seven steps of TZ v4 4.3; a bypass is recorded and surfaced in diagnostics

fixes.defect: probe() returned REQUESTED from capability flags alone, before anything was requested
fixes.resolution: New CAPABLE state; REQUESTED only after launchWindowed actually asks

fixes.defect: Any recreatedOnRotate classified an app as unstable, though Activity recreation is normal Android behaviour
fixes.resolution: Instability requires stateLost, crashed, brokenGeometry, inputLost or restartLoop

fixes.defect: Gesture geometry was remembered against the View instance, which is identical across a rotation, so it went stale
fixes.resolution: All values from state-backed Compose sources; correct after rotation, IME, density and resize

fixes.defect: debug and release carry different applicationIds, inviting false conclusions
fixes.resolution: HomeStatus.installedPackage reports the running package in every diagnosis
